summary: Gix Internet Ltd., a dual-listed (Nasdaq: GIXI; TASE: GIX) Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 12, 2026 press release announcing that autonomous robots operated by its wholly-owned subsidiary deliverz.ai have begun delivering blood and bone marrow at Sheba Medical Center, Israel's largest hospital and a global top-10 facility, expanding an existing chemotherapy-medication robotics project. The filing discloses no transaction terms, no stake, no price per share, no premium, no board recommendation, no advisor, no regulatory clock and no structural mechanics; it is purely an operational/commercial milestone update. The risk-arb angle is limited, as this is a product-deployment disclosure rather than a special situation, and it may nonetheless influence sentiment around GIXI's Physical AI narrative.
